source.interpretation: RIFF/WAVE PCM16LE at 44100 frames/s. Treat left as I and right as Q at a 3205 kHz center and zero offset (member label, no tuning or GPS in WAV). Uncalibrated nominal sample clock.

conversion.clock: Compensated linear-phase FIR: output k is centered at original time k/12000. All source input frames processed with block support; zero extension only at file ends. Ceil-rounded last output pair.
conversion.demod_input: The frozen IQ demodulator resamples each 12 kHz window to 48 kHz and supplies stereo PCM16 to Dream.

settings.scheduler: KCBS_DREAM points to the pinned finite-input Dream binary. Set KCBS_SIGNALLING_BITS to the unique raw path for each cold reception. The passive hook emits FAC/SDC after channel decoding, before interpretation.
settings.coverage: One pass per window. The two boundary overlaps contain repeated samples from the same recording.

selection.primary: First three-phase CRC-complete group by earliest original phase-zero row in baseline window 0. Preserve the selected counter whatever mode or later-window reception yields. No complete group in window 0 gives a null primary.
selection.coverage: Report every window individually. For the whole-file union, deduplicate original packets by counter, phase, continuity and compare all shared bytes. Quarantine conflicting alternatives; require all four packet CRCs and the native DU CRC for a complete DU, and all three ordered DUs for a group.
selection.signalling: Report complete-window and block CRC counts per pass. Callback counts across the two overlaps include repeated samples; do not convert repeated signalling byte patterns to unique transmission occurrences.

novelty.primary_check: Report whether the fixed primary counter already occurs in the frozen registry; when it does, report an overlap and retain its identity without claiming a novel primary. Do not substitute any later counter.
novelty.recording_check: Separately intersect all physically assigned counter IDs (including packet-only) from all three windows with the same registry, list overlaps, and report whether the entire recorded span passes this observed-coordinate check.

chronology: Selection fixed from RIFF/DAV metadata, source checksum and previous transport receipts. No sample interpretation prior to receiver release.
